description:
Preserve the checker’s infrastructure exit status when the CI wrapper runs it under the host build lock.

## Background

`scripts/cargo-ci.sh` invokes `flock -E 75` and treats every returned 75 as lock-acquisition timeout. The child checker also returns 75 for a loaded-host execution failure. During test-topology recovery, run `448d0665-ddfb-4a46-aaf8-4d30cb15ca4f` passed all tests but exceeded the suite-duration budget at load 9.74; the wrapper replaced its infrastructure result with a false lock-timeout diagnostic and exit 2.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: A child checker returning infrastructure status 75 after lock acquisition retains status 75 and emits no lock-timeout diagnostic.
- [hard] REQ-02: Genuine lock-acquisition timeout remains bounded, reports the lock path and timeout, and preserves the documented environment-error outcome.
- [hard] REQ-03: The owning shell self-test proves both outcomes through the real wrapper without running the workspace suite or depending on host load.
- [hard] REQ-04: Existing checker pass/fail status propagation, locking, and suite budgets remain intact.

## Notes

The coordinator approved this targeted addition to the test-topology scope after the recovery run exposed the shared-tooling defect. The implementation footprint is the wrapper and its existing shell self-test.
title: Preserve infrastructure status through the CI build lock
